plan.notes: Official CSUDH Academic Catalog 2025-2026, Health Science B.S. program page, 'Community Health Option Roadmaps' 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid), Total Hours 120. All semester sums reconcile with printed Hours (12+16+15+14+15+15+18+15=120). Courses marked * in the source 'must be taken within that semester' per the roadmap footnote. Statistics requirement is a choice (MAT 131 / MAT 132 / MAT 134) at 3 units. 'HEA Elective (from list below)' slots reference the roadmap footnote: HEA 300, HEA 319, HEA 465, HEA 477, HEA 495 (repeatable). GE recommendations (THE 100, PSY 110, SOC 102, BIO 102/103, CHE 102, LBR 200, CHS 212, HUM 300) preserved in choice notes. HEA 468 satisfies GE 4UD; HEA 466 satisfies GE 5UD. HEA 496/497 require internship coordinator approval per source. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.
